Anime Shuffle

Find your next anime from what you already enjoy.

Too many shows, no idea what to watch? Anime Shuffle is a free anime discovery tool that learns from your reactions. You do not need to give every show a numerical rating.

Start discovering anime

Four reactions, two different questions

How you felt about a show you finished is different from whether you want to try a new one. Anime Shuffle keeps those signals separate.

  • Good: you have seen the anime and enjoyed it.
  • Bad: you have seen it and did not enjoy it.
  • Would watch: you are interested; save it to your watchlist.
  • Won’t watch: you are not interested in trying it.

You can skip a title when you are unsure, undo a reaction, or add a reason to explain what worked for you. Reactions do not change your MyAnimeList scores.

Get started without a MyAnimeList account

  1. Open Discover and follow the introduction to choose favorite anime and viewing preferences.
  2. React to titles you know and save new ones you would like to watch.
  3. As you build your taste profile, explore Recommendations and use Watchlist to choose what to watch next.

You can try Anime Shuffle as a guest. The guest profile is kept in this browser; signing into an Anime Shuffle account enables cross-device sync. See the privacy policy for how guest diagnostics and account data are handled.

Connect MyAnimeList when you want to

An optional MyAnimeList connection brings viewing history into your recommendations and Plan to Watch entries into your watchlist. Viewing statuses can help even when you rarely rate anime. Adding your site saves to MAL is a separate action unless you turn on auto-add.

Look beyond one popularity score

Viewing preferences, your reactions, and available information about each anime help shape your picks. You can choose formats, genres, and length preferences, read why a title was suggested, and preview available trailers before deciding.

Recommendations are suggestions, not guarantees. A new or lightly used profile has less information to work with; your choices help refine it over time.

Anime Shuffle helps you discover shows. It does not stream anime and is not affiliated with or endorsed by MyAnimeList.

Free to use, optional to support

Tips help with hosting and development. They do not unlock features or change recommendations.
